Lag computed only for comparable fresh positions; missing evidence is unknown (AC-2)
nodes.rationale: No freshness guarantee is derived only from time since last replay; missing or expired WAL evidence is reported as unknown and excludes replica admission.

nodes.label: Bounded authenticated probes with dedicated monitor role
nodes.rationale: Reachability alone cannot identify a safe writable primary or a sufficiently current replica, so probes authenticate with a least privilege monitor role, fixed queries, verified TLS and reserved capacity.

nodes.label: Health failure alone produces no promotion (AC-4)
nodes.rationale: Monitoring failures are kept separate from administrative mutation authority; promotion caused by health failure is an explicit non goal.

nodes.label: Monotonic observation expiry measured at admission
nodes.rationale: The age of an observation is measured at admission so a delayed publisher cannot extend its lifetime; eligibility expires by its freshness bound even if the last published status was Healthy.
